title: Fly en espaol
script:
loadstring([[
    local Player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
    local Character = Player.Character or Player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local Root = Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local Humanoid = Character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

    local Flying = true
    local Speed = 70
    local ColorHUD = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)

    -- Crear UI Principal
    local sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui", Player.PlayerGui)
    sg.Name = "VueloJustinHUD"
    sg.DisplayOrder = 999
    
    -- Botón de Encendido/Apagado
    local btnToggle = Instance.new("TextButton", sg)
    btnToggle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 50)
    btnToggle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -75, 0.8, 0)
    btnToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    btnToggle.TextColor3 = ColorHUD
    btnToggle.TextSize = 18
    btnToggle.Text = "VUELO: ON"
    btnToggle.BorderSizePixel = 2
    btnToggle.BorderColor3 = ColorHUD

    -- Botón Aumentar Velocidad (+)
    local btnUp = Instance.new("TextButton", sg)
    btnUp.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 50)
    btnUp.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 85, 0.8, 0)
    btnUp.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    btnUp.TextColor3 = ColorHUD
    btnUp.TextSize = 25
    btnUp.Text = "+"
    btnUp.BorderSizePixel = 2
    btnUp.BorderColor3 = ColorHUD

    -- Botón Disminuir Velocidad (-)
    local btnDown = Instance.new("TextButton", sg)
    btnDown.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 50)
    btnDown.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -135, 0.8, 0)
    btnDown.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    btnDown.TextColor3 = ColorHUD
    btnDown.TextSize = 25
    btnDown.Text = "-"
    btnDown.BorderSizePixel = 2
    btnDown.BorderColor3 = ColorHUD

    -- Fuerzas de vuelo
    local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity", Root)
    bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)
    local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro", Root)
    bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)

    -- Funciones de los botones
    btnToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        Flying = not Flying
        if Flying then
            btnToggle.Text = "VUELO: ON"
            btnToggle.TextColor3 = ColorHUD
            Humanoid.PlatformStand = true
            bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)
            bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)
        else
            btnToggle.Text = "VUELO: OFF"
            btnToggle.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
            Humanoid.PlatformStand = false
            bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landing)
        end
    end)

    btnUp.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        Speed = Speed + 10
        print("Velocidad: " .. Speed)
    end)

    btnDown.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        Speed = math.max(10, Speed - 10) -- No baja de 10
        print("Velocidad: " .. Speed)
    end)

    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if Flying then
            bg.CFrame = Camera.CFrame
            bv.Velocity = Camera.CFrame.LookVector * Speed
        end
    end)
]])()
